subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

She has / not written / a single novel / by three years.
solution:
The erroneous segment is 'by three years'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in **'By three years'** part of the sentence.
 
• Instead of 'by' we will use 'for' .
 
• For is used in this case :** For + period of time ** - ** for** six years**, for** a week,** for** a month,** for** hours, **for **two hours.
 
 
• **Example***: I have worked here **for five years.***
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

3c
